main.description: Append a single POSITION FIX to a craft's append-only trail in the kotoba Datom log (:craft.fix/*). The latest fix per craft (max observedAt) IS its current position; the fix stream IS the trajectory (非終末論 — appended, never overwritten). Fixes derive ONLY from public transponder broadcasts: AIS (source=ais) or ADS-B (source=adsb). kotoba-native successor to maps vertex_vessel_position / vertex_aircraft_state (RisingWave) — see MIGRATION-NOTES.md. watari G2 (situational, not surveillance) + G4 (no person-tracking / no pattern-of-life).

latE7.description: latitude in degrees × 1e7 (integer-encoded; AT lexicon disallows floats). Maps to :craft.fix/lat (double) in the kotoba store.

altM.description: geometric altitude in metres (aircraft); omit/0 for surface craft

speedKnE1.description: speed over ground in knots × 10 (integer-encoded; AT lexicon disallows floats)

courseE1.description: course/track over ground in degrees true × 10 (integer-encoded)

lane.description: :lane/id currently transited (resilience signal; NOT a route-to-intercept)

source.description: which public broadcast carried this fix
